steps.text: Board on its day or night side
Remove cards and Merchant tiles marked for more players than you have
Wild Location and Wild Industry cards faceup on 2 Card Draw Areas; shuffle the rest facedown on the third as the Draw Deck
Shuffle the Merchant tiles; 1 faceup on each Merchant space marked for your player count
steps.note: 2 players: none in Warrington or Nottingham; 3 players: none in Nottingham

steps.text: 1 beer barrel on each barrel space beside a non-blank Merchant tile
Coal Market: a black cube on every space except one of the 1-pound spaces
Iron Market: an orange cube on every space except both 1-pound spaces
Remaining cubes and barrels as the General Supply; money as the Bank
Each player takes a Player Mat and {n} pounds
Choose a Character tile; matching Link tiles in your area
Stack your Industry tiles on their mat slots, black-top side facedown
VP marker on 0 and Income marker on 10 of the Progress Track
Draw {n} cards as your hand, plus 1 more facedown as your Discard Pile
Shuffle all Character tiles and place them in random order on the Turn Order Track
First round of the Canal Era: follow the Turn Order Track
